texts.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have made great strides in ridding the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of the superstitions and primitive beliefs that plagued their society. They are beginning to see the value of science and rationality.

label.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
label.en: They will thank us one day.
